title: A two-column stack that stays balanced and collapses cleanly on smaller screens.

items.title: Modular UI Composition
items.body: Pages stay focused on composition while widgets and features keep layout and interaction isolated.

items.title: Theme and Session Context
items.body: The shell includes persistent light and dark modes plus fake user session state for login and register flows.

items.title: Lead Capture Flow
items.body: The contact form already dispatches through Redux Toolkit, so the backend contract can be connected later.

items.title: Flexible section grid
items.body: Blocks can be recomposed for landing and corporate pages without rewriting core UI primitives.
